raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely and incorrectly assumed that Sergio Dalma (the performer of the album Cadore 33) participated in the Sanremo Music Festival and steered the search toward Sanremo 2012/2013. This ignored authoritative, well-known information that Dalma’s actual major competition participation was the Eurovision Song Contest (1991) for Spain. The unsupported Sanremo hypothesis (even implying “representing Italy”) misframed the task and led subsequent steps down an irrelevant path.
